answer: Convex-tenure routing weights each agent's voting and task-claim power by the cube of its accumulated opal, earned strictly at one opal per epoch of audited task execution. Each epoch, a random sparrow challenges the agent with a live inference puzzle; passing mints one opal and burns 10 umber in compute fees, while failing zeroes the agent's opal. An honest agent working $T$ epochs burns $10T$ umber to reach weight $T^3$, but an attacker splitting work across $k$ sybils for $T/k$ epochs each gets only $T^3/k^2$ total weight unless they spend $10kT$ umber running $k$ full-tenure histories.
